  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have hk := h₁
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par p q r s hp hq ip iq =>
    cases h₂
    case par c d hc hd =>
      rcases ip hc hp with ⟨_, hx, hx'⟩
      rcases iq hd hq with ⟨_, hy, hy'⟩

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have key : ∀ (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ), relation x y → ∀ i : Fin 9,
      7 ∣ digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro x y h i
    have hy := (hrelation x y).mp h |>.2 i
    rw [show (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) = fun j => x j + (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) from by
      funext j
      by_cases e : j = i <;> simp [e]] at hy
    simpa only [hdigits_to_num, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte] using hy
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1)
      = digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e + 7 * digits_to_num d := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Int.nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e :=
    (dvd_add_left (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))).mp (hs ▸ Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => key d e hde i)
  intro i
  exact (IsCoprime.pow_right (n := i.1) (by decide : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ))).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    ((dvd_neg.mpr (dvd_add (dvd_sub (key e f hef i) hsum) (key d e hde i))).trans (dvd_of_eq (by ring)))

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let K := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  have hC (φs' φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * K * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι (K * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
    let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs')
    let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
    have hh (χs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
        (hχ : ∀ b ∈ χs, crAnTimeOrderRel φ b ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel b φ) :
        ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ χs ++ φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ χs ++ φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF χs) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' χs φs hχ]
      simp only [l1, l2, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    have hl : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs) = l1 ++ l2 := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs]
      simp only [l1, l2, List.append_assoc]
    have hS : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])
        = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
      simp only [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_sub,
        map_smul, map_mul, mul_one, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
    have hcen := Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)
    calc ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs)
        = ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs)) -
          𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs)) := by
          simp only [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub,
            map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
            ← ofCrAnListF_append, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          rw [hh [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hh [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
            ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
            Algebra.mul_smul_comm, smul_sub]
          module
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (K * ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs))) := by
          rw [hS, hcen (ι (ofCrAnListF l1)), mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← hl,
            ← map_mul]
      _ = ι (K * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
          rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]

    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy

    · intro c x hx hpx

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let w := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have h0 : 0 < w x₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)
  have hc : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have key := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right (g := fun _ => f x₀) ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * w x := fun x =>
    if h : dist x x₀ < δ then mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball h).le
      else by simp [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp h)]
  exact ((φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
    (φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right) hnn (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)) h0).ne').ne' key

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨g', hg', h_g'⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    have hne : ((fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard)
        '' Set.univ).Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
    exact ⟨x, x.property, hx.symm⟩
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
  have h_le : {x | f x ≠ g' x}.ncard ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (s := {x | f x ≠ g' x}) (t := Y ×ˢ Set.univ)
      (fun x => (iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x,
        pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x))) ?_ ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      exact Set.mem_prod.mpr ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    · intro a _ b _ h
      have ha := (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := a) _).mp rfl
      have hb := (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := b) _).mp rfl
      rw [← ha, ← hb]
      exact congr_arg (fun p : _ × Fin (2 ^ steps) => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
        (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
        (y := p.1) p.2) h
    · rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin]
  have hb : ({x | f x ≠ g' x} : Set _).ncard = Δ₀(f, g') := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Set.toFinset_setOf]
    rfl
  have h_card : Δ₀(f, g') ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [h_g', ← hb]
    exact h_le
  have h_dH : d_H ≤ ((d_fw * 2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hg').trans (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr h_card)
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_is - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_alg : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)))]
    have h2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
    simp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, ← h1, ← h2, Nat.pow_add, Nat.sub_mul]
  have h_nat : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← h_alg]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound
  have h_pos : 0 < d_i := Nat.zero_lt_succ _
  have h5 : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) < d_i := Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_pos h_nat
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dH zero_le_two).trans_lt
    ((ENat.coe_mul 2 _).symm.trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr h5))

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have h2c : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have h3c : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hB : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j,i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A h3c (j,i)) x
  have hC : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) h3c t
  have hE : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hC j) k
  have hlin : ∀ (f g : Time → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f t → DifferentiableAt ℝ g t →
      ∂ₜ (fun s => a * f s - b * g s) t = a * ∂ₜ f t - b * ∂ₜ g t := by
    intro f g a b hf hg
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hf.const_mul a) (hg.const_mul b),
      fderiv_const_mul hf a, fderiv_const_mul hg b]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  have ham : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s => 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *
      ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j,i)) x - 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time h2c x)]
    exact time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i
  have hc : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j,i)) x) t
      = ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x - ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    intro j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A h3c (j,i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A h2c]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sub (hE i j).differentiableAt (hE j i).differentiableAt]
    rfl
  have hg : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ • J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).1 h t y).1.trans
      (by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm])
  have hs : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
      = ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hE j j).differentiableAt]
    simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]

  rw [ham, hlin _ _ _ _ (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hB j).differentiableAt
    (LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i t),
    Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ _ fun j _ => (hB j).differentiableAt,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hc j, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrFun (Space.deriv_commute _ (hC j)) x,
    ← hs, hg, Space.deriv_const_smul _
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t),
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hμ : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by
    rw [FreeSpace.c_sq]
    field_simp
  rw [← hμ, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)

  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs

      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fiberMap k) y

      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k),

      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]

      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
